estimand: source native mean May and August sown aboveground dry biomass g/m2; log1p. Original planned guild-count and guild-presence predictors, C(exact planted species richness)+C(original block)

independent_verification.method: Pandas/statsmodels formula reconstruction, independent source parsing and 256 exact identity-pair swap enumeration

conditional_design_warning: Only 8 two-plot strata in the richness=2 treatment permit swaps keeping exact species richness, original block and planted group count unchanged. This conditional reference distribution is not a causal test for all 62 Jena plots.

comparison_to_Cedar_E120.Cedar_guild_groups: C3 grass/C4 grass/nonlegume forbs/legumes plus separate Woody treatment
comparison_to_Cedar_E120.interpretation: Independent experiments show different within-experiment patterns; lack of comparable guild definition and Jena conditional support prevents evidence of uniform ecological assembly rule.

hard_nonclaims: Selected after seeing earlier Jena and Cedar results; exploratory not independent preregistered replication
Plant guild identities are confounded with original species mixtures; not causal nitrogen fixation or complementarity
May Jena p=.309 and exact 256 conditional reference p=.5 do not establish biological equivalence or no identity effects
Four experimental blocks are not four geographically independent sites
Jena seasonal standing sown biomass and Cedar early annual teaching biomass are not source-identical
No new evidence for family×trait phylogenetic memory rho, community quantitative FD Rao Q or global biomass theory
